FAIL_TO_PASS: return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
remove-unused-wellknown-hasInstance: removes unused Symbol.hasInstance from objects
object-freeze-effects: Only treats Object.freeze as a side effect if the argument is used
preset-with-override: allows using the "preset" option with overrides
function-iterable-prototype: Removes unused functions where the prototype is iterable
side-effects-switch-statements: switch statements should be correctly tree-shaken
empty-if-statement: removes an empty if statement
safest: handles treeshake preset "safest"
side-effects-call-arguments: side-effects in call arguments should be included
break-statement-labels: supports labels when breaking control flow
break-statement-labels-in-loops: handles breaking to loops inside labeled statements
using-statement-symbol-usage: preserves Symbol.dispose side effects when used in using statement
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
side-effects-object-literal-mutation: detects side-effects when mutating object literals
empty-switch-statement: removes an empty switch statement
multi-expression-calls: handles side-effect-free multi-expressions
inlined-namespace-static-resolution: statically resolves Symbol.toStringTag for inlined namespaces
follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
known-globals: does not consider it a side-effect if a known global variable is accessed
true: handles treeshake preset true
